run_generate_cli_reference: run generate_cli_reference to regenerate the CLI reference markdown from the hf CLI implementation
check_and_update_cli_reference: check_and_update_cli_reference to verify or update the generated CLI reference documentation file
print_colored_diff: print_colored_diff to display a colored line-by-line diff between expected and current CLI reference content
run_cli_reference_update: run the script with --update flag to re-generate the CLI reference markdown if changes are detected
run_cli_reference_verbose: run the script with --verbose flag to show a detailed colored diff when content mismatch is detected
